title: csharp-minifier features
description: What each switch does, as implemented, and the repository setup that follows a run that changes files.

entities.name: Allow read-only commands (--allow-reads)
entities.description: Lets agents run read-only shell commands in the repository without asking, so unattended sessions do not lose turns to refusals.
entities.behavior: Runner.Run runs RepoSetup.AllowReads first, as a plan: it merges Bash allow rules for ls, cat, head, tail, wc, grep and rg into permissions.allow of the repository's .claude/settings.json, keeping other settings and rules, and changes nothing when they are all there. On its own it writes nothing else; with --check it reports the missing rules; with --benchmark it applies to the clone and names the results folder allow-reads.
entities.outcome: A repository, or a benchmark clone, where agents read without permission prompts.
constraints: find is never allowed: -exec and -delete make it anything but read-only.
A settings file that is not a JSON object is left unchanged and reported.

entities.name: One test file per method under test (--split-tests)
entities.description: Each test moves to <ClassUnderTest>/<MethodUnderTest>.cs, decided by what its // When section calls.
entities.behavior: TestMethods.In finds methods with an xUnit, NUnit or MSTest test attribute; UnderTest.Load compiles every readable .cs file under the root, and UnderTest.Resolve binds the outermost calls, constructions, member and element accesses and operators between // When (or // Act) and // Then (or // Assert) to methods or properties declared in source outside the test files; exactly one such member is the target. SplitTests.Make moves each resolved test into <base>/<Class>/<Method>.cs (base is the file's folder, or its parent when that folder is already named after the class), declared in the same namespace and type chain made partial (TestFileText.PartialEdits), creating the file (TestFileText.NewFile) or extending it (TestFileText.Extend); a test that cannot be resolved stays and gets the TestMethods.MarkerPrefix comment with its reason; a stale marker on a test already in place is removed; files left with nothing worth keeping are deleted.
entities.outcome: Test files are small and named after what they test, and the tests the split could not place are marked for a person or agent to fix.
constraints: All or nothing: when a destination cannot be extended, the set of tests would change token for token, or new syntax errors would appear, nothing is changed (SplitTests.Verify, SplitTests.Failed).
Calls bind only against the .NET 8 reference assemblies and the tree's own source, so a // When that only calls a NuGet package is unresolved (UnderTest.Load).
A // When that calls several members, or none outside test files, is unresolved.
Generated files and files the compilation did not load are skipped with a note.

entities.name: Report without changing (--check)
entities.description: The commands plan their changes and report them as violations; nothing is written.
entities.behavior: Runner.Run makes each command's Plan but does not apply it: it prints '<switch> would change <change>' for every change, prints notes and errors, skips the repository setup, writes a summary naming the command to run on standard error, and exits 1 when anything would change or a file failed. The pre-commit block RepoSetup writes runs it on the staged .cs files.
entities.outcome: A hook, CI job or agent can tell whether a tree is in the layout without touching it.
constraints: It cannot be combined with --rename or --list-identifiers (Cli.Parse).
Each command sees the files as they are on disk, not what the previous command would have written, because nothing is applied between steps.

entities.name: Identifier tree (--list-identifiers)
entities.description: Prints the namespaces, types and members declared under the paths as an indented tree.
entities.behavior: Identifiers.Build parses each file and adds dotted namespaces one level per part, types, delegates, methods, properties, events, fields and enum members to an IdentifierNode tree; IdentifierTree.Render prints it with a fixed indent per level, names sorted within a level and a colon after a name that has children. Runner.Run writes it to standard output and exits 0.
entities.outcome: A person or agent gets the vocabulary of a code base on one page, in the format --rename reads back.
constraints: It must run on its own (Cli.Parse).

Generated and unreadable files are left out; overloads and partial parts share one line; constructors, finalizers, operators, indexers and explicit interface implementations have no line (Identifiers.Names).

entities.name: Rename from an edited tree (--rename <file>)
entities.description: Applies 'name => newName' lines of an identifier tree to the code, with every reference, and moves the files that follow the names.
entities.behavior: IdentifierTree.Parse reads requested names deepest first. Rename.Make loads the Roslyn workspace, renames each symbol and its references, preserves strings and comments, rejects added compiler errors, and asks FileMoves.Plan to move namespace, type and test files. Runner.Run performs renames before other requested commands.
entities.outcome: Names change across the whole tree in one step, and the file layout the other commands keep follows them.
constraints: Nothing is written when a line does not parse, a new name is not a valid C# identifier, a path is not declared, the renamer changes nothing, the renames raise the count of any compiler error, or a move would land on an existing file.
It cannot be combined with --check, and the rename file must exist (Cli.Parse).
Constructors, accessors, operators and indexers cannot be named (Rename.Nameable).

entities.name: Work on a tree and limit the run (--root and paths)
entities.description: Chooses the tree a run works on and, with paths, which files the commands rewrite.
entities.behavior: Cli.Parse validates the root and requested paths. Runner.Run discovers sources under those paths, skips generated and build output, and includes each plan's written sources for subsequent steps. Test binding and rename workspaces read the root; repository guidance and hooks record the selected root.
entities.outcome: One repository can hold several trees, each set up and checked with its own switches.
constraints: Paths must lie inside the root (Cli.Parse); bad usage exits 2 with the usage text (Program.cs).
Paths limit which files are rewritten; --split-tests and --rename still read every .cs file under the root to resolve symbols.

entities.name: Repository keeps the layout
entities.description: After a run that applies a command, the repository gets the skill, an AGENTS.md section and a pre-commit check for that root.
entities.behavior: After test-layout commands without --check, RepoSetup.Run writes the embedded skill, refreshes the selected root's marked AGENTS.md and hook blocks, creates CLAUDE.md when missing, and merges read-only permissions. It retains only supported switches from earlier hook blocks. The guidance requests complete relevant symbols or bounded ranges and resolving referenced constants, fields and attributes. Existing search ignore files are untouched.
entities.outcome: Agents and people working in the repository later are told the layout and cannot commit C# that breaks it.
constraints: Not run with --check, or for --list-identifiers, --rename or --allow-reads alone.
Outside git, guidance and settings update without installing a hook.
The hook checks the working-tree copy of each staged source path.

entities.name: Measure agent token use on a clone (--benchmark)
entities.description: Clones the root beside itself, applies any transforming switches to the clone, and runs each prompt file three times in fresh Claude CLI sessions, storing the token counts per repository, commit and prompt.
entities.behavior: Cli.ParseBenchmark requires --benchmark (a prompt file, or a folder whose .txt and .md files are used), --model and --effort, and allows only --root and the transforming switches beside them. Benchmark.Run copies the root to benchmark-<name> in the same parent with cp -Rc (cp -R --reflink=auto on Linux), replacing only a folder that carries its marker, then runs Runner.Run on the clone with the transforming switches. Each prompt goes on standard input to claude -p with the model, the effort, --output-format stream-json --verbose, --no-session-persistence and --permission-mode dontAsk, in the clone, three times. BenchmarkStore writes meta.json (repository, origin, commit, uncommitted changes, prompt path and SHA-256, switches, model, effort, CLI version and arguments), prompt.txt, transform.txt, run-1..3.jsonl (the CLI's stream), run-1..3.json (its result event) and summary.json: per run the token counts, turns, tokens per turn, tool calls, denied tool calls and the tokens of turns whose every tool call was denied, and per turn its tokens and the tools it called with what each was pointed at (BenchmarkStream.Turns); and whether runs 2 and 3 are within 10% of each other, took the same number of turns and called the same tools.
entities.outcome: Token use of the same prompts can be compared across commits, models, efforts and layouts, with the first run warming caches.
constraints: Results go to ~/.zazzle/agent-token-benchmarks unless ZAZZLE_BENCHMARK_DIR is set; ZAZZLE_BENCHMARK_CLAUDE replaces the claude program (BenchmarkStore.Root, Benchmark.ClaudeProgram).
dontAsk denies every tool that would ask for permission, so sessions read the clone but do not edit it or run commands.
Exit code 1 when any session failed or returned an error.
